result.stdout:
Description:
  Build, test, and debug your AI coding environment like software.

Usage:
  axm [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  doctor          Check the repo's health: its instruction files in any repo, and every asset when it holds a vault.
  validate        Check every asset and print only the problems, for CI and hooks.
  list            List the vault's assets by kind, with maturity, version and harness support.
  explain <path>  Show which instruction files each harness loads for a file, and which it drops, each with its rule.
  triggers        Find skills whose descriptions overlap in each harness's listing, and the terms they share.
  hook            Hooks for Claude Code to run. Each reads the hook's JSON on stdin.

Description:
  Show which instruction files each harness loads for a file, and which it drops, each with its rule.

Usage:
  axm explain <path> [options]

Arguments:
  <path>  The file to explain. It needn't exist yet, but its folder must.

Options:
  --harness <all|claude-code|codex>  Only this harness. [default: all]
  --cwd <cwd>                        Where the harness starts. Defaults to the repo root, or the current directory outside a repo.
  --diff                             Only the files one harness loads and the other doesn't.
  --json                             Print JSON. Its shape is a contract, versioned by schemaVersion.
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information

result.stdout:
Description:
  Find skills whose descriptions overlap in each harness's listing, and the terms they share.

Usage:
  axm triggers [command] [options]

Options:
  --root <root>   Where to start. The harnesses launch at the repo root above it, and the vault there or at --root adds its skills. Defaults to the current directory. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-axioma-4c59d9be-92456bec]
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

Commands:
  generate <skill>  Have Claude Code write trigger prompts for a vault skill, show them, and write them after you approve.
  test <skill>      Run each vault skill's trigger prompts on the real harnesses, and report which skill each run picked.
  export <skill>    Print a vault skill's trigger prompts in a format other skill-eval tools run.

  scope-sheriff   Warn the agent when an edit leaves the task's scope in .axm/scope.
  session-doctor  When a session starts, tell the user and the model what axm doctor finds wrong. Silent when all is well.
